notes:
Merged old 'Liquid egg' (k101) and 'Dried egg' (k102) into one 'Liquid & dried egg' kind. Liquid whole, white and yolk plus egg powder are now types. Kept the shared Canadian trade-notice source.

Hen's egg: size, housing, shell colour, breed eggs (Burford Brown, Cotswold Legbar) and omega-3 enrichment are now types, not kinds. Dropped three SKU-level variants of brands already listed:
- Vital Farms Restorative Pasture-Raised Eggs
- Vital Farms True Blues Eggs
- Suguna Heart
This leaves one line per brand: 6 models, covering US, Indian, Latin American and Slovenian PGI examples. Added 'chicken egg' as the plain English alias and kept the existing Japanese alias.

Preserved egg: renamed from 'Preserved or boiled egg'. The maker-less 'Pidan (century egg)' entry was a type, not a model, so it moved into types.

Duck and quail eggs: kept as model-free kinds, with definitions slightly clarified.

All kinds keep their old sources. No archetypes, new kinds or brands were added.
